Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
if :system.cursor_value is null
then
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
else
 begin
 select chapter_name into :ctrl_block_1.chapter_name
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_block_1.chapter_id and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('5005');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
end if;
--
:system.message_level := '10';
go_block('group_sites');
execute_query;
:system.message_level := '0';

Item.Name: GROUP_SITE_ID
Item.Hint: Enter a site or group ID

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t_rowid VARCHAR2(30) := NULL;
begin
 if :group_sites.group_site_id is null
 then
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
--
-- Check for duplicate group_site_id
--
 begin
 select rowid into t_rowid
 from group_sites
 where group_site_id = :group_sites.group_site_id and
 chapter_id = :group_sites.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
 if nvl( t_rowid,'NULL') != nvl(:group_sites.rowid,'NULL')
 then
 show_error ('5191', :group_sites.group_site_id );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the date from which this group/site is effective [DD-MON-YYYY]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 IF :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 THEN
 IF trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(SYSDATE)
 THEN
 show_error('8044');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF :term_date is not NULL and
 trunc(:eff_date) > trunc(:term_date)
 THEN
 show_error('8045');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
END;

Item.Name: TERM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter the last date on which this group/site will be active [DD-MON-YYYY]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 IF trunc(:term_date) < trunc(:eff_date) THEN
 show_error('8052');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_GROUP_SITE
Trigger.Comment:
This trigger is present instead of WHEN-VALIDATE-RECORD, as address block
& group_sites block need to be validated togethe
Trigger.TriggerText:
break;
if :system.record_status in ('NEW' ,'QUERY')
then
 return;
end if;
--
-- Check all fields are entered
--
if not :group_sites.group_site_ind in ( 'G' , 'S' )
then
 show_error ('5190');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
--
if :group_sites.site_name is null then
 show_error ('0080');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
--
if :group_sites.eff_date is null then
 show_error ('5002');
 check_package_failure;
end if;
--
-- Check that effective date is >= today
--
if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
then
 if trunc(:group_sites.eff_date) < trunc(sysdate)
 then
 show_error ('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;
--
if :group_sites.term_date is not null
then
 if trunc(:group_sites.term_date) < trunc(:group_sites.eff_date)
 then
 show_error ('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end if;

 -- check_package_failure;
-- end if;

Trigger.Name: KEY-EXIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
if not :system.cursor_block = 'CTRL_BLOCK_1'
then
 go_block('addresses');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('group_sites');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('ctrl_block_1');
 clear_block;
else
 exit_form(no_validate);
end if;
